The '''1981–82 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 46th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 6 September 1981 and ended on 30 May 1982. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their third consecutive and 23rd Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
